item.title: Why the gender debate is failing young men
item.description:
Boys and men are falling behind in education, employment, family life, mental health and a sense of purpose. How did we get here, and where do we go next?
Host Megan McArdle is joined by Richard Reeves, president of the American Institute for Boys and Men and author of “Of Boys and Men,” to discuss the widening gender divide. They explore why the crisis facing boys and men is so often obscured by gender politics and what modern fatherhood can look like.
This episode was originally published May 20.
